exposure: type of labour in the first pregnancy
Type of labor in the first pregnancy (spontaneous, induced, Cesarean section without labor)
Type of labor in first pregnancy
cohort: Low-risk, nulliparous women in Nova Scotia who delivered at term in their first pregnancy and had at least one subsequent pregnancy
finding: The absolute risks for severe maternal morbidity outcomes in subsequent pregnancies were small (regardless of the type of labor in the first pregnancy).
mod_finding: The type of labor in the first pregnancy influenced the subsequent risk of postpartum hemorrhage and blood transfusion.
